rationale: Record two append-only WindowHost queries that let a host answer whether its last rendered frame reached its intended output, so the Development Inspector's gpu_submission_observed flag has a producer instead of being permanently false. The macOS GPU host is the only implementer and it reports the render::frame_reached_output() verdict it already computes to decide damage retirement; a recreate outcome reports false, and every other host keeps the false default. This adds no rendering primitive, acquires no drawable, and introduces no presentation producer. It also corrects a documentation error this watch lane previously recorded: capture completion does not precede display. The health adapter stamps that timestamp after capture_back_buffer_png() returns, which is after the present call plus PNG encode, and the capture's synchronising readback blocks between submit and present, so capture completion over-reports first-visible latency rather than under-reporting it. native_present_timing stays listed in missing_trace_categories and no transferred Vellum slice changes behaviour.
